verdict.rationale: Clerk documents first-party session management with active device monitoring and session revocation, and shows a per-device "Sign out of device" action in the user profile UI. That covers the user-side view and individual revocation. Nothing in the evidence shows an admin-facing session view or a bulk revoke-all action. Missing for 10: admin visibility into and revocation of user sessions, revoke-all-sessions capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can let users and admins see active sessions and devices and revoke them individually or all at once

citations.quote: Clerk manages the full session lifecycle, including critical security functionality like active device monitoring and session revocation
